name: constraint-scope
body: The write-surface enforcement of the constraint-scope law: `rust.apg.layers.validate.eval_constraint`, reached by both the write path `rust.apg.layers.write.validate_change` and the scan path `rust.apg.layers.tree.ingest_tree`, refuses an `attaches-to` property on a new constraint, so a constraint's layer is its only scope. `apg spec lint` reports every constraint that already carries one.
